name: @blobatar/angular
description: Angular adapter for blobatar — deterministic geometric avatars.
//exports: Into ng-packagr's layout rather than the flat `dist/index.js` every other adapter has, because ng-packagr is what builds this one — see `scripts/build.ts`. `module` is there for the Angular CLI's older resolvers; `exports` is what everything current reads. `./package.json` is written as an object, which means the same as the string form every other package uses: ng-packagr merges these entries into the manifest it generates by adding conditions to each, and a string has none to add to.
//peerDependencies: `blobatar` is pinned to an exact major, not `^2` — see `@blobatar/vue`'s note for the full account (ADR-0008: the major names the generation, so a mixed pair is the wrong picture, not a version skew). Angular's floor is 17.3: signal inputs, `viewChild()` and built-in control flow are all this component is written in, and partial compilation links against any later major.
//devDependencies: `typescript` is pinned to the range Angular 19's compiler supports, independently of the workspace's. Bun's isolated linker gives this package its own copy, so ng-packagr and `ngc` resolve it rather than the root's.
author: Andre
